metadata.title: SpaceX Stock Today Has These 2  Positives. The Stock Is Still Falling.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
SpaceX Stock Today Has These 2 Positives. The Stock Is Still Falling.
SpaceX stock was falling in premarket trading Thursday, dipping below its initial public offering price of $135 in June, following a new Buy rating on Wall Street and more buying from growth investor Cathie Wood.
